inputs.text: The Punjab and Haryana High Court has made it harder to revoke pre-arrest bail, saying that missing stolen articles and serious allegations aren’t enough without clear proof that liberty was misused or circumstances changed. Justice Sumeet Goel dismissed a plea to cancel bail in a house case. That may be framed as a safeguard, but it also creates a convenient shield: if evidence is hard to produce or kept out of sight, the accused can remain protected while the public is told the rules were followed.
